issues: 纯黑底上一束白色细线，像一张平面线框图，读不出"地景"：所谓景深只是三张平面层横移，近景两条斜虚线像镜头上的划痕
主干和支流同色同粗，没有主角；全片唯一的强调色是淡长春花蓝，画面整体灰白发冷、没有光
标签 7 枚挤在画面中下部一条横带上，等宽小字和白方块像散落的噪点
收尾只有汇点一团模糊白光，没有落点、没有字，结尾帧不是一张海报
changes: look 换成 lime（石墨暗场 + 荧光黄绿）：主干是唯一的黄绿主角并带泛光，支流是灰绿细线、源头淡汇入处亮
从平面横移改为真透视地景：线画在针孔投影的地平面上，主干从镜头脚下蜿蜒奔向右 1/3 的消失点；景深/视差/雾全部由投影深度算出（近处逐段进 11px 模糊层、远处雾化），地面点阵随前飞涌来
相机低空沿河道前飞 + 横向缓移，bezier 减速：开场即在飞、尾段缓停接字，全程不急刹
6 枚 issue 标签改为「图钉 + 短立杆 + 等宽 ID 胶囊」，按透视近大远小（25px×0.7–1.7），位置逐帧投影核过不重叠，近的遮远的
收尾：消失点亮起一团黄绿光，天空落 30px 等宽眉题 + 两行 108px 标题「Every thread, / one release.」逐词升起；时长 165→180f
issuesEn: A bundle of thin white lines on pure black read as a flat wireframe, not a landscape: the "depth" was three flat layers sliding sideways, and the two blurred diagonal foreground lines looked like scratches on the lens
Trunk and tributaries shared one colour and weight, so there was no hero; the only accent was a pale periwinkle, leaving the frame grey, cold and unlit
Seven labels crowded one horizontal band in the lower middle; the small mono text and white squares read as scattered noise
The ending was just a blurry white glow at the merge point, with no landing and no type; the last frame was not a poster
changesEn: Lime look (graphite dark with fluorescent yellow-green): the trunk is the single glowing yellow-green hero, while tributaries are thin grey-green lines that brighten toward the merge

Flat panning is replaced by a true perspective landscape: lines sit on a pinhole-projected ground plane, and the trunk winds from under the lens to a vanishing point on the right third; depth of field, parallax and fog all come from projected depth (near segments go to an 11px blur layer, far ones fade), and a ground dot grid rushes toward camera
The camera flies low along the river with a slow lateral slide on a decelerating bezier: already moving on frame one, easing to rest for the title, never braking hard

Six issue labels become pin + short stem + mono ID capsule, scaled by perspective (25px x 0.7 to 1.7), with positions projection-checked per frame so they never overlap and nearer labels occlude farther ones
Ending: the vanishing point blooms yellow-green, and a 30px mono kicker plus a two-line 108px headline "Every thread, / one release." rises word by word in the sky; duration 165 to 180f
